name: Malampaya Depletion Compression Platform (DCP, Phase 3)
location: Adjacent to the Malampaya shallow-water platform, ~50 km off Palawan
description: substructure_type: Self-installing platform with inbuilt jacking system and 80 m legs (small fixed platform) | topside_type: Depletion compression topsides, bridge-linked to existing CGS platform | water_depth: Shallow water (same area as existing platform, 43 m) | topside_weight: 4,300 t topsides; ~12,000 t load-out weight (Fluor); OGJ reports a 13,000 t platform — source-specific values | installation_method: Self-installing: built to float, towed from Keppel Shipyard, Subic; inbuilt jacking system jacked 80 m legs down and lifted platform out of water into final position; set in place in less than 24 hours in February 2015 — no large specialised installation vessel needed | contractor: Fluor (engineering, procurement, construction support); Arup (engineering support for self-installing substructure); Keppel Shipyard Subic (fabrication) | dates: Fabrication ~2013-2015 (approx. two year
notes: Producing (gas production from new platform announced Oct 2015)
